_README: Public-readiness blocklist for wick-public-readiness.mjs. Each category groups patterns that should NOT appear in files shipped publicly. Patterns can be 'literal' (substring match, case-insensitive) or 'regex' (full regex with case-insensitive flag). Allowlist below records files with known-legitimate uses of otherwise-blocked terms (e.g. a CHANGELOG entry that documents removed filenames). See SECURITY.md for the disclosure pipeline this scanner is part of.

model-identifiers.reason: Specific internal-deployment model identifiers should not be public. Public base models (Qwen2.5-7B, Llama, Mistral) recommended in training guides are NOT in this category — they are customer-facing fine-tuning targets, not internal architecture disclosure.

infrastructure-endpoints.reason: Internal infrastructure endpoints reveal deployment topology.

internal-codenames.reason: Codenames for non-public internal projects, repos, or programs.

internal-roles.reason: Names of internal-only role personas. Reveals architecture that customers do not need to know.

internal-apprentice-names.reason: Names of internal apprentices not yet shipped publicly.

allowlist._README: Per-file allowances. If a file legitimately mentions a blocked term (e.g. a CHANGELOG entry honestly documenting a removed file), list the term here. The scanner will skip these specific term/file pairs while still catching unintended new uses. Use sparingly and document the reason.
